# Hytera IP Multi-Site Connect packets built by the dmrgo hytera and layer2 encoders on
# 2026-10-20, not copied from any capture. The octet values follow facts that the DO1KBL
# and gw_hytera_mmdvm captures of Hytera_Homebrew_Bridge show: port 50002, mark 00 50,
# octets 9 to 15 00 05 01 01 00 00 00, octets 24 and 25 40 B8, call type 0, and the
# heartbeat and P2P field values. The call is a Voice LC header, one superframe of
# silence and a terminator on slot 1, color code 1, from 3002068 to talkgroup 91. Then
# come a sync packet, two heartbeats, a keepalive, and the P2P register, accept,
# redirect and acknowledgement. Each line is: kind, packet in hex.
